Overall, this clinic is considered good. I've received dental services here 1-2 times. The other dentists were gentle and gave good advice. The service from the staff and assistants was polite and attentive to patients. The overall atmosphere was impressive.
However, during my orthodontic treatment, I met one dentist (if I remember the name correctly, Dr. Teerasak) whose communication and service, from my personal experience, felt lacking in detail. During treatment, he seemed rushed and engaged in personal conversations with his assistant, which made me feel uncomfortable.
For these reasons, I decided to transfer my case to another clinic. This is just my personal experience, but from what I've heard from people around me, some have had similar feelings.
Nevertheless, I still maintain that the clinic's overall service is good. I just would like to suggest improvements in communication standards and attentiveness during treatment to make patients feel more confident and comfortable.
